Promotion record: promotion class, source/target scope refs, eligibility state, blocking refs, review/corroboration refs, decision outcome, revocation/reopen lineage
Recovery record: recovery kind (safe-point restore, restart reconciliation, etc), target scope, trigger reason, preconditions, result, attempt/run linkage, affected concern refs
Review record: `review_id`, review kind (package/seam/verifier), target scope refs, reviewer identity, criteria/profile, findings summary, finding refs, verdict/decision, timestamps
Rule: keep records and artifacts separate; record = canonical structured Ledger object, artifact = file/blob linked from record
